title: Augsburger Straße, Königsbrunn
description:
Looking for a cozy, fully furnished room?

If you're a student, young professional, or expat looking for a comfortable and stress-free place to live, this room in a shared appartment is perfect for you!

The apartment is fully furnished, so no need to worry about buying furniture or setting things up. You can move in with just your suitcase and feel at home right away. It’s a quiet, clean, and well-maintained space, ideal for focused work, relaxation, and a peaceful atmosphere.

---

12 m2 rooms → €575 (All - inclusive)
---

✨ What’s Included in the Rent?

✔ Fully furnished room (bed, wardrobe, desk, chair, shelves)
✔ Bright & modern kitchen (shared) with stove, fridge, dishwasher, and kitchenware
✔ High-speed WiFi – ideal for home office, studying, or streaming
✔ All utilities covered (heating, electricity, water) – no extra costs!
✔ Washing machine & dryer available in the building
✔ 5th floor with elevator – no carrying heavy bags up the stairs!
✔ Clean, well-maintained living environment

There’s no large shared living room, but the kitchen is a nice space for cooking and casual chats.
